type V = { v: number };
type P = { xs: V[] };
const p: { xs: { v: number }[] } = { xs: [{ v: 1, w: 2 }] };
function f(p: { xs: { v: number }[] }): number { return p.xs.length; }
f({ xs: [{ v: 1 }, { v: 2, w: 3 }] });
const q: { xs: { ys: { v: number }[] } } = { xs: { ys: [{ v: 1, w: 2 }] } };
const a = [{ v: 1, w: 2 }];
const r: { xs: { v: number }[] } = { xs: a };
const t: { xs: [{ v: number }, string] } = { xs: [{ v: 1, w: 2 }, "s"] };
const u: { xs: { v: number }[][] } = { xs: [[{ v: 1, w: 2 }]] };
console.log(({ v: 1, w: 2 }) as V);
console.log(({ x: { v: 1, w: 2 } }) as { x: V });
console.log(({ xs: [{ v: 1, w: 2 }] }) as P);
console.log([{ v: 1, w: 2 }] as V[]);
console.log(({ xs: [{ v: 1, w: 2 }, { v: 3 }] }) as P);
console.log(({ xs: [{ w: 2 }] }) as P);
console.log(({ x: { ys: [{ v: 1, w: 2 }] } }) as { x: { ys: V[] } });
console.log(({ xs: [{ v: "s", w: 2 }] }) as { xs: V[] });
console.log([
  { v: 1, w: 2 },
  { v: 1, w: 3 },
] as V[]);
console.log(p, q, r, t, u);
